issues.body: The new public module-level documentation uses the intra-doc link `verifier::bind_entailment`, but `bind_entailment` is a private function in `verifier.rs`. Public documentation linking a private item triggers the `rustdoc::private_intra_doc_links` warning; with the repository's warnings-as-errors/all-features rustdoc gate, this is a gate failure. The link may also be unresolved from this module without a crate-qualified path, but making it crate-qualified would not solve the private-item problem.
issues.fix_hint: Replace the intra-doc link with plain code formatting such as `verifier::bind_entailment` (backticks without link brackets), or link to a genuinely public API that represents the check. Run the all-features rustdoc portion of the clippy gate to confirm there are no private or broken intra-doc links.
issues.title: Public rustdoc links to private bind_entailment function

verdict.summary: The fail-closed policy logic and its end-to-end tests are coherent, and the documentation consistently preserves the research-grade/not-externally-audited qualification. However, the new public module documentation links to a private verifier function. This is the exact feature-gated rustdoc failure class called out by the repository's review contract and is expected to fail the all-features documentation gate, so the PR is not ready to approve.
